data.desc: American Resources Corporation (NASDAQ:AREC) operates a capital-efficient critical materials platform focused on sourcing, aggregating and supplying rare earth and critical mineral feedstocks to domestic and allied processing and refining markets. Through its Platform Orchestration strategy, the Company coordinates resource sourcing, feedstock origination, recycling, industrial processing and strategic commercial relationships to connect diverse mineral resources with advanced refining capabilities. The Company's business model emphasizes disciplined capital allocation, diversified supply sources and strategic partnerships, supported by its ownership interest in Electrified Materials Corporation and strategic minority ownership interest in ReElement Technologies Corporation.
